stem.en: How do electromagnetic waves travel through the vacuum of space?

label.en: They cannot; a medium is always required
label.et: Nad ei saa; keskkond on alati vajalik

label.en: By a changing electric field generating a changing magnetic field, and vice versa
label.et: Muutuv elektriväli tekitab muutuva magnetvälja ja vastupidi

label.en: By being carried along by other particles
They do not travel, only their energy does
label.et: Nad ei levi, ainult nende energia levib
